title: Cycle 1.2: The Banewaters Brawl
name: The Banewaters Brawl
intro: Nobody claims the Banewaters. It is a sump of toxic runoff where old synth stills still drip into the sludge, and the locals give it a wide berth. Most of the stills are long dead, but one still works, and anyone with the right buyers could turn what it brews into credits.

So when {t:The Midnight Theatre} quietly lay claim to it, it should have meant nothing. The Delaque like places nobody watches, and a working still in a forgotten sump suits them well. Their whisper network already has buyers lined up.

But {p:The Carrion Psalm} have not forgotten the Pyroclave. That promethium was meant for their fires, a blessing tricked out of worthy hands by Delaque deceit. {@mordecai|Mordecai} has had his people watching the Theatre ever since, and when word comes that the Delaque are heading into the Banewaters, the Psalm get there first and wait for them in the dark.

facts: Increase the AP of Toxin (X) weapons by 1

Face Off: the winner of a roll-off picks a battlefield edge and their opponent takes the opposite one. Each gang deploys between its own edge and a line 9" from the centre line. On a 2' table that is a 3" strip along each edge, 18" apart.

Turf War: from round three onwards, a gang wins in the Check for Victory step if it is the only one with models that are not Seriously Injured within 6" of the centre (9" in the book). If only one gang still has models on the battlefield, they win; if neither does, it is a draw.

{t:Settle a Score:} once both crews are deployed, one enemy model other than their Leader is picked at random. If it has been taken Out of Action, or has left the battlefield for any reason, by the Check for Victory step of any End phase, the side job is done. Target: {p:Ratsong}.

{p:Settle a Score:} once both crews are deployed, one enemy model other than their Leader is picked at random. If it has been taken Out of Action, or has left the battlefield for any reason, by the Check for Victory step of any End phase, the side job is done. Target: {t:Skimbleshanks}.

Scouting Force: Both gangs use Hybrid (D3+5). Both gangs rolled a 1, for 6 fighters each.
{t:Theatre:} 6 fighters, 715 rating
{p:Psalm:} 7 fighters, 875 rating, including Ratsong as an extra Bonepicker from Without Number

text: {t:The Midnight Theatre} navigate the toxic sump waters and approach from the south, through the ruins of an old Synth Still manufactorum complex. Their target is a functioning still in a relatively clear area of the ruins. {p:The Carrion Psalm} lie waiting near a sealed ventilation tunnel on the opposite side of the clearing.

ends.alt: Delaque fighters deployed either side of the stacked containers and inside the ruined tower.
ends.caption: The Midnight Theatre come to claim the still…

ends.alt: Cawdor fighters on the sealed vent, beneath it beside the stairs, and the Stig-Shambler by the ruined stills.
ends.caption: …but the Carrion Psalm lie in wait.

text: {@mordecai|Mordecai} gives the word and {@deus-and-amen|Deus} kicks Amen forward. He charges his twin heavy stubbers and swings them round to open fire at the shapes in the shadows. Rounds fly across the clearing and kick up rubble and debris around {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks} and {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon.

text: As soon as the Cawdor make their presence known, {@demeter|Demeter} climbs the ruined tower to find a vantage point to cover the Theatre's advance.
But {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} is watching from the top of the sealed vent. The Psalm's sniper takes position behind a stack of crates and fires.

The shot cracks against the iron bars in front of {@demeter|Demeter}, forcing him to duck back and stay behind cover. Below him, {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks} rushes forward through the hail of lead from {@deus-and-amen|Deus}, getting out of the narrow alleyway killzone and into the cover of a ruined wall.
On the sealed vent, {@ratsong|Ratsong} scurries up behind some crates to keep {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth}'s flank covered.
With the battle now underway, {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} draws on the voices of the Psychoteric Choir and reaches into the dark, wrapping himself in a Perfect Void.

rows.note:
Note: +1 from Psychoteric Choir, for being within 3" of two friendlies.
Rules note: I got this wrong. Deuteronomy should have taken a Maintain (Single) action for the Continuous Effect to persist after his activation.

text: Cloaked in silence, he follows the advance towards the centre. Opposite, {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah Emberchoir} strides forward into the central clearing, reciting a hymn of Redemption.
{@jellylorum|Jellylorum} follows the main Delaque advance, staying back to provide support. He notices {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} on the vent above and raises his lasgun.

The las-bolt strikes true and the Psalm's sniper crumples. Not wanting to get caught in a shooting war with the Delaque, {@mordecai|Mordecai} rushes forward into the clearing. He drives his congregation on, calling on the faithful to keep pace.
{@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} rushes forward into the cover of the wall around the still and hip-shoots his plasma gun at {@deus-and-amen|Deus}, just visible atop Amen as he strides through the ruins.

rows.note: Note: Rumpleteaser uses Hip-shooting to rush to the wall and fire on Deus.

text: The bolt flashes past {@deus-and-amen|Deus} and off into the dark, and the coils of the plasma gun fade to a dull glow. {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel Crows} rushes into the clearing, confident in the protection of the God-Emperor.

{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} follows {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks}' lead and rushes into cover beside him. Finally, {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} follows his Word Keeper and takes his place at his side. Both gangs now stand within reach of the centre.

text: The Theatre are quicker off the mark. {@demeter|Demeter} is still pinned behind the iron bars of the tower and can't watch over the clearing, so {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} takes matters into his own hands. He slams a fresh cell into his plasma gun, leans out from the wall around the still and fires at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} as he crosses the clearing.

roll.name: Rumpleteaser - Plasma Gun
roll.result: Ezekiel seriously injured, Out of Ammo

text: The plasma bolt drops {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} in the middle of the clearing, and seeing their champion fall shakes the Psalm.

rows.note: Rules note: I got this wrong. Nerve tests should only be taken when a friendly fighter is taken Out of Action, not Seriously Injured, so these tests should not have happened.

text: {@mordecai|Mordecai} holds his nerve, but {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} and {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} hesitate and drop into cover. {@deus-and-amen|Deus} pushes Amen further into the ruins and rakes the wall around the still with stubber fire, but the rounds only chew into the stonework.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon.

text: {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks} slips along to the next section of wall and opens fire on {@mordecai|Mordecai} with both pistols.
{@mordecai|Mordecai} barely flinches. {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} won't stay down any longer. Driven by Redemptionist zeal, he breaks from cover and charges at {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks}.

rows.note: Note: Used the Adrenaline Surge tactic for an extra action, allowing him to charge from suppressed.

text: He stumbles to a halt an inch short of the Ghost, alone in the open, and {@demeter|Demeter} finally has a clear shot from the tower.

roll.name: Demeter - Long Rifle
roll.result: Elijah takes a wound and is suppressed

text: In the middle of the clearing, {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} crawls back towards {@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor}, who drags him into cover and gets him back on his feet.

rows.note: Note: +1 die from Gutter Cantor assisting.

text: {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} steps out from behind the Theatre's line and puts a las-bolt into {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah}, but it glances off the Deacon's armour. The impact still forces him to keep his head down.
Up on the sealed vent, {@ratsong|Ratsong} moves to the crates beside the fallen {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} and takes a shot at {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}, but the stub gun can't reach that far.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} keeps the Perfect Void wrapped around him.
He walks calmly towards the wounded Deacon and raises his flechette pistol.

rows.note: Note: Battlefield effect increases the AP of Toxin weapons by 1.

text: The poisoned needles find the gaps in {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah}'s armour and he collapses. Up on the vent, {@ratsong|Ratsong} tries to get {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} back on his feet, but the sniper is too badly hurt.

rows.note: Note: +1 die from the Tend Wounds action, +1 die from Ratsong assisting.

text: {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} creeps up to the fallen Deacon, kneels beside him and whispers. {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} slips into an Eternal Slumber, out of the fight.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} shakes off his fear and tends to {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}'s wounds.

{@mordecai|Mordecai} has watched his Deacon fall. He strides forward and fires on {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks}, still standing by the wall where {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} fell short, and the Ghost goes down.

ports.alt: Ezekiel Crows lying fallen at the foot of the stairs, with Gutter Cantor standing beside him and Mordecai to the right.
ports.caption: Ezekiel down, with Gutter Cantor close by.

roll.name: The Carrion Psalm - Bottle Check
roll.result: The Psalm bottle, Blessed Filth flees

rows.note: Blessed Filth flees. He later recovers and does not succumb to his wounds.

text: Shaken but not broken, the Psalm act first. {@deus-and-amen|Deus} drives Amen on through the ruins and sprays stubber fire at {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}. Up in the tower, {@demeter|Demeter} holds his fire, waiting for a better target.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon.

text: {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} gets his plasma gun working again and takes another shot at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}, but it goes wide and the gun runs dry once more.

{@mordecai|Mordecai} sees {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks} lying at the foot of the wall and charges across the open ground to finish him. It's the moment {@demeter|Demeter} has been waiting for, and he fires on Overwatch.

rows.note: Note: Mordecai was not suppressed, did not take a wound and did not roll an Injury die, so his activation is not interrupted.

text: The round hits {@mordecai|Mordecai} and knocks him back a step, but it doesn't stop him.
He reaches {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks}, stands over him and raises his chainglaive.
He brings it down, and the Ghost won't get up again. Seeing one of their own executed shakes the Delaque, and {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} freezes.
{@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} keeps the Perfect Void in place and charges {@mordecai|Mordecai}, his shock stave crackling.
Back on his feet, {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} advances across the clearing and empties his autopistol at {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} behind the wall.

roll.name: Ezekiel - Autopistol
roll.result: Rumpleteaser takes a wound and is suppressed

text: {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} takes careful aim at {@ratsong|Ratsong} up on the vent.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} follows close behind {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} and binds another of his wounds.
Still shaken, {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} slips back into cover.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} ducks back behind the crates.

ports.alt: Mordecai standing over the fallen Skimbleshanks with his chainglaive.
ports.caption: Mordecai stands over Skimbleshanks.

text: The Delaque move first, but {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser}'s plasma gun is empty and he's wounded, so he falls back behind the wall rather than waste the turn.
In the middle of the clearing, {@mordecai|Mordecai} and {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} are still locked in combat. Mordecai swings his chainglaive.
The chainglaive finally bites into {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}. Behind the wall, {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} reaches {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} and patches up his wound.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus} swings Amen round towards the tower to fire on {@demeter|Demeter}, but the sniper has been watching him.

roll.name: Demeter - Overwatch
roll.result: Deus and Amen take a wound and are suppressed

rows.label: Save (6+ AP -1)
rows.result: One wound caused, Suppressed and activation interrupted

rows.note: Note: Overwatch finishes Deus and Amen's activation.

text: {@demeter|Demeter}'s shot hits the Stig-Shambler before he can fire, and {@deus-and-amen|Amen} staggers to a halt. {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} keeps the Perfect Void in place.
Then he strikes back at {@mordecai|Mordecai}.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} pushes forward and fires at {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} again, undoing {@jellylorum|Jellylorum}'s work.
{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} leans out of cover and takes an aimed shot at {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel}.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} moves up beside {@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} and fires back at {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} stays behind the crates on the vent, out of sight.

ports.alt: Deus and Amen seen through the window of the ruined tower, past a blurred Delaque fighter.
ports.caption: Demeter stops Amen in his tracks.

photo.caption: Mordecai and Deuteronomy locked in combat.

text: The Psalm strike first. {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} is quicker, and both men know it, but {@mordecai|Mordecai} has no choice: the Delaque leader has to fall. He swings his chainglaive.

rows.note: Note: Mordecai is subject to the Webbed condition: he cannot move and suffers -1 to all hit rolls.

text: {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy}'s web gauntlet snares {@mordecai|Mordecai} in sticky strands, but even webbed, his swing finds its mark. The glaive cuts through Deuteronomy's coat and the Master of Shadow collapses in the clearing. {@rumpleteaser|Rumpleteaser} falls back again, still unable to reload.
{@ezekiel-crows|Ezekiel} spots {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} on his own and charges him.

roll.name: Ezekiel Crows - Charge
roll.result: Fails to wound, fails to hit

text: Every swing of the cleaver misses. {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} steps inside his reach and hits him with his bare hands.
{@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees} fires at {@mordecai|Mordecai}, then slips back into the shadows.
{@deus-and-amen|Deus} pushes Amen forward and fires at {@demeter|Demeter} in the tower.

roll.name: Deus and Amen - Twin-linked Heavy Stubber

rows.note: Note: Bulging Biceps to move at Initiative and fire a heavy weapon. Twin-linked to re-roll the Rapid Fire dice.

text: {@demeter|Demeter} takes an aimed shot at {@mordecai|Mordecai}, a chance to take down the Psalm's leader in return.
{@gutter-cantor|Gutter Cantor} takes aim at {@mistoffelees|Mistoffelees}.

Still held fast by the webbing, {@mordecai|Mordecai} cannot follow up, and {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} crawls away from him towards {@jellylorum|Jellylorum}. His wounds are too deep, and he passes out before he gets there. It's a lesson he won't forget.
{@ratsong|Ratsong} stays safe on the vent, and {@jellylorum|Jellylorum} slips back into the dark. When the smoke clears, only the Psalm are left standing in the clearing around the still.

aftermath.result: {p:The Carrion Psalm} take the Synth Still

prose: The Delaque slip back into the ruins, dragging {@deuteronomy|Deuteronomy} with them, and the Banewaters belong to the Psalm. Old Deuteronomy has lived many lives, and this won't be his last. He recovers, but losing to the Word Keeper is a lesson he won't forget. {@skimbleshanks|Skimbleshanks} isn't so lucky. The Psalm carry him away from the clearing, and he is executed. On the Psalm's side, {@blessed-filth|Blessed Filth} makes a full recovery, but {@elijah-emberchoir|Elijah} is left with a Grievous Wound from the poisoned needles and the Eternal Slumber.
